category: Product discovery beyond usual categories is difficult
description: Customers cannot easily find products outside their regular categories. The search-first experience and lack of curated discovery keep them locked in their existing purchase patterns.
examples: I only come here for milk and bread, never find other products worth adding.
The app shows me the same things I already buy. I never see new categories.
Search works but I have to know what I want, so I don't explore.

description: There are no meaningful recommendations for complementary products across categories, so customers do not add new categories to their basket.
examples: I buy bread but never get suggestions for butter, jam or spreads.
No 'complete the meal' or 'frequently bought together' prompts.
Cart page doesn't suggest anything from related categories.

category: Low trust when trying new categories
description: Users avoid trying new categories because product information, expiry, packaging and substitutes feel uncertain, increasing perceived risk.
examples: I don't order new items because I'm not sure of quality or expiry.
Substitutes in a new category are risky; I can't trust it.
Need better product photos and reviews before trying something new.
